name: Necklace
covers: necklaces, chokers, haar, rani haar, mangalsutra, pendant sets, temple jewellery necklaces, kundan and polki sets
checks: the number, shape and colour of the stones, in their real order
the metal finish: gold, antique gold, oxidised silver, rose gold
the pendant or centrepiece: its shape and size relative to the neck
the length: where it sits (choker at the throat, princess at the collarbone, long haar on the chest)
drops, pearls or ghungroos hanging from it: their count and length
shot: Close, from just below the chin to the chest, so the necklace fills the frame at its real size; a plain or low neckline so nothing covers it.
poses: three-quarter turn, the necklace catching the light
